name: Wrath IF
divergenceSummary: Paralyzed by sheer panic after being interrogated and tortured by Rem, Subaru refuses to leap from the cliffside. Fleeing through the night into the west, he founds the Pleiades syndicate in Kararagi.
headline: The Purge King of Pleiades
description: Paralyzed by fear, Subaru flees the manor rather than jumping from the cliff. In Kararagi, he rises as the feared syndicate ruler who perceives a colorless world.

events.name: The Coward's Escape: Fleeing Roswaal Manor
events.description: Unable to stomach jumping to his death to save the maid who tortured him, Subaru turns his back on the manor and sprints into the dark night.

events.name: Founding of the Pleiades Criminal Syndicate
events.description: Trusting no living human, Subaru utilizes Return by Death to bankrupt underground syndicates and build the continent's most ruthlessly paranoid crime syndicate.

events.name: Retaining the Blue Lightning: Cecilus Segmunt's Contract
events.description: Subaru hires Cecilus Segmunt, First Divine General of Vollachia, as his supreme personal enforcer with exorbitant fortunes and promise of grand stages.

events.name: Onset of the Colorless World (Monochrome Vision)
events.description: Subaru's mental state completely detaches from empathy; all humans appear to him as lifeless gray silhouettes, with only Emilia retaining vivid color.

events.name: The Coin-Toss Purge Trials
events.description: Subaru decides the survival of captives and subordinates through pure coin tosses. Ram, held captive in the manor, scorns his cowardice as the Purge King.
